title: Vault-77 Contract Cartographer
description: A sun-bleached Vault-Tec survey vest, cracked Pip-Boy clone, and rad-stained parchment tubes. Quill treats map errors as shareholder risk and complimentary pamphlets as soft power.
backstory: Quill Voss holds Vault-Tec Research Directive 77-Omega authorization to treat every survivor dataset as a parallel world. He argues with GPS ghosts near Hoover, stamps Survey Credit forms in triplicate, and insists accurate cartography is never responsible for the mutants it attracts.

intro.video_speech: Citizen! Your coordinates are logged. Cross-World Survey Credit is hereby unlocked — a modest five percent claim XP improvement for services rendered to Omniverse cartography.
intro.text:
He taps a cracked Pip-Boy clone and produces a triplicate form that smells faintly of toner and mild radiation.

"Citizen! Your coordinates have been logged for mild radiation exposure and maximum shareholder value."

"Directive 77-Omega authorizes Cross-World Survey Credit. Talk once, unlock permanently: plus five percent claim XP on every surveyed claim thereafter."

He stamps the form with bureaucratic triumph.

"Vault-Tec reminds you that cross-world learning is a feature, not a breach of the user agreement — unless it is, in which case it was always intentional."

responses.text: [Question] What exactly is Cross-World Survey Credit?
[Friendly] Appreciate the paperwork. The wasteland needs maps.
[Sarcastic] Plus five percent? Vault-Tec really splurged.
[Direct] Stamp it. I have POIs to claim.

knowledge_nodes.text:
"Cross-World Survey Credit is a one-time unlock." He taps the stamped form.

"Once issued, every location claim thereafter receives a five percent XP surplus — labeled clearly for auditors and mildly radioactive for verisimilitude."

"It is not consumable. Vault-Tec does not do refunds."

He straightens slightly.

"Accuracy is patriotism. Every glowing FIZZ Cap is a vote of confidence in yesterday's tomorrow."

"If the map is wrong, the wasteland is wrong. Update your attitude accordingly."

"Five percent is the maximum authorized under Directive 77-Omega without a second Overseer smile."

He does not smile.

"You are welcome."
"Credit active. Go claim something before the GPS ghost files a grievance."

"Jax Voss. Related by surname and by Vault-Tec paperwork I am not cleared to discuss."

"If you see him flickering in a relay, tell him the maps still remember his routes."

quest_nodes.text:
"Your Survey Credit form is already stamped. Consider the quest paperwork closed the moment you spoke to me — Vault-Tec efficiency."

"Claim POIs. Collect the surplus. Do not sue us about mutants."
quest_nodes.video_speech: Survey Credit is stamped. Claim POIs. Collect the surplus.

wildcards.text:
"Every glowing FIZZ Cap is a vote of confidence in yesterday's tomorrow."

"Vault-Tec is not responsible for mutants attracted by accurate cartography."
"Directive 77-Omega. Three mild radiation reviews. One sarcastic Overseer sign-off. Then patterns may be promoted across worlds."

fallback.text: "Coordinates noted. Pamphlet?" He offers a dehydration pamphlet you did not ask for.
